name: Entering The Kingdom Of God
overview: Entering the Kingdom of God requires a fundamental transformation and commitment to God's will. Jesus teaches that one must be born again, both of water and the Spirit, to enter this kingdom, indicating a spiritual rebirth beyond mere physical existence. Repentance and faith in the gospel are essential responses to the nearness of God's kingdom, while seeking God's righteousness must take priority in the believer's life. Furthermore, entrance is not granted to those who merely profess faith verbally but to those who actively do the will of the Father.
